documentation: Records claim-level SOL-reviewed original source pages and abstracts. This register is not a downloaded original-web HTML, certified exact Raw, complete independent benchmark, or Core Accepted Discovery.

items.claim_level_first_party_or_raw_observati: Anthropic: Sonnet 5.5 introduction. Vendor states 30%+ faster and up to 30% cheaper than Sonnet 5; benchmark scores require source/effort-qualified attribution.
items.unresolved: Opus 5.5 release Sep22 is pre-window; do not merge Opus community adoption into fresh Sonnet release.

items.claim_level_first_party_or_raw_observati: NVIDIA: Open Agent Safety Platform with OpenShell runtime enforcement and Sentry out-of-band BlueField-4 monitoring.
items.unresolved: Reference architecture/vendor security claim, not independently demonstrated attack-proof containment.

items.claim_level_first_party_or_raw_observati: AMD: definitive agreement to acquire World Labs led by Fei-Fei Li.
items.unresolved: Agreement is not completed acquisition; reported $8.2B valuation/price has not been first-party validated.

items.claim_level_first_party_or_raw_observati: OpenAI: proposed evidence-based safety-case guidelines for frontier reinforcement-learning training.
items.unresolved: Aspirational goal/guidance, not assertion every training run currently uses a certified safety case.
